en.intro: This Mecha Love keychain features Pingu and Pinga and is sold on Japan's official Pingu online store. A FeelBetter concierge checked the model, stock and price, and after you order we buy it there and ship it to you.
highlights: It features Pingu and Pinga, so you get both characters in a single accessory.
As a keychain, it attaches to your keys or bag and adds a cute accent.
The product name includes “Mecha Love”, so you can match it with the listing on the Japanese store.
It is bought from Japan's official Pingu online store, so you receive genuine merchandise.
It makes an easy gift for Pingu fans.

sections.p: Clip it onto your keys or a bag to carry a little Pingu and Pinga with you. If you are looking for another Pingu item, our concierge can help through the request page.

highlights: Pingu와 Pinga가 담겨 있어서 두 캐릭터를 키링 하나로 만날 수 있어요.
키링이라 열쇠나 가방에 달아 귀엽게 포인트를 줄 수 있어요.

Pingu를 좋아하는 분께 부담 없이 드리기 좋은 선물이에요.
